pages.name: French Defense: Alekhine-Chatard Attack, Spielmann Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Ng5 with no knight in reach and a Bxh7 sacrifice with the bishop still on f1. Rewrote plan 1 (Bd3 first, then Bxh7+ and the queen to h5); British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: French: Chatard-Alekhine, Breyer, 7.Bxe7 Kxe7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a Qd2-g4 queen route that is not a line and a knight manoeuvre to g3. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French: Chatard-Alekhine, 6...Bxg5 7.hxg5 Qxg5 8.Nh3 Qe7 9.Nf4
pages.notes: Plan 1 named g6 as a target move and a Rh1-h3-g3 lift; plan 3 had an f2-f4 break with the knight on f4. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in overview and plan 2.

pages.name: French Defense: Classical Variation, Alapin Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 named the threat as Nc7 (c7 holds a pawn: it is Nxc7+) without saying why c7 hangs. Rewrote overview and both plans.

pages.name: French: Classical, Steinitz, 7...a6
pages.notes: Plan 3 had ...Qb6 with the queen on e7, which cannot reach b6. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Classical, Steinitz, 7...a6 8.Nf3 c5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Qb6 with the queen on e7. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in overview and plan 1.

pages.notes: Plan 3 aimed White's queen's bishop at the queenside after it was exchanged on e7; plan 4 named f8 and c4 as moves. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling in plan 2.
